title: Max Lab expands diagnostic services network with new laboratory in Panipat
summary: The facility will offer pathology, genomics and oncology testing to address demand for diagnostic services in Haryana
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
The facility will offer pathology, genomics and oncology testing to address demand for diagnostic services in Haryana

Max Lab, the diagnostic services arm of Max Healthcare, has expanded its presence in Haryana with the operationalisation of a diagnostic laboratory in Panipat.

The expansion is part of Max Lab’s efforts to strengthen access to diagnostic services across the country, particularly in emerging healthcare markets.

The laboratory aims to address the demand for diagnostic services in Tier II cities by bringing testing facilities closer to patients. Equipped with diagnostic technology and supported by quality protocols, the facility will offer a range of tests, from routine pathology investigations to specialised diagnostics, including advanced genomics and oncology testing.

With diagnostics playing a role in early disease detection, clinical decision-making and treatment planning, the expansion is expected to support healthcare professionals with timely and accurate test results. It also reflects Max Lab’s focus on strengthening diagnostic infrastructure and extending access to healthcare services beyond metropolitan cities.

Commenting on the expansion, Arpan Malhotra, Director and COO, Max Lab, said, “The expansion of our diagnostic network in Panipat is an important step towards enhancing access to reliable and advanced diagnostic services in the region. Diagnostics play a critical role in clinical decision-making, influencing the course of treatment and enabling timely intervention. With the rising burden of chronic diseases and growing awareness around preventive healthcare, the need for accurate and accessible diagnostic testing has become increasingly important. At Max Lab, we remain committed to our ‘Patient First’ philosophy, ensuring that patients have access to quality diagnostic services backed by advanced technology and stringent quality standards.”

Max Lab has a presence across 60+ cities, supported by over 1,700 patient touchpoints. Through its network and diagnostic portfolio, the company continues to work towards strengthening India’s diagnostic ecosystem by delivering testing services.
